en: Nitrogen makes up about 78 percent of Earth's atmosphere, while oxygen makes up about 21 percent.
Solid ice is about 9 percent less dense than liquid water, which is why ice cubes float.
You can dissolve up to 360 grams of table salt in one liter of water at room temperature.
Pure gold is 24 karats and is 99.9 percent gold, while 14-karat gold is only 58.3 percent pure.
Pure water boils at exactly 100 degrees Celsius at sea level, but boils lower on Mount Apo.
A single drop of water contains roughly 1.5 sextillion water molecules, showing how incredibly tiny molecules are.
Whole milk is a colloid containing about 3.25 percent butterfat globules suspended evenly throughout liquid water.
Over 99 percent of the visible universe is made of plasma, a superheated state of matter.
Mixing 5 grams of baking soda with 100 milliliters of vinegar produces roughly 1.3 liters of carbon dioxide.
Diamond is the hardest natural mineral, scoring a 10 on the Mohs scale, while talc scores a 1.
Average ocean water contains about 35 grams of dissolved salts per liter, making it 3.5 percent salt.
The metal gallium melts at exactly 29.76 degrees Celsius, so a solid piece turns liquid in your hand.
